rows.scope: Static kernel-state/live-host-progress criterion only; no unconditional execution or measured bottleneck claim.
rows.reason: Host flags are updated/read only between kernels. Native RUN macro calls cudaDeviceSynchronize after every stage, then host branches on managed globals. Julia run does the same before reading/writing its four UnifiedMemory flags. No CPU responder is required while a kernel runs.
qualifications: Restore all mutated global/static device arrays and managed flags for each pass; native has __device__ symbol storage and __managed__ control globals, Julia has CuArray/managed pointers.
Host-controlled iterative stage/state trajectory and full assignments/cost/slack/guards must still pass. First-per-name/geometry is not every adaptive iteration.

Managed control-page residency and host solver overhead are not represented by kernel DRAM counters. This is not evidence of floating-point roofline applicability for predominantly integer combinatorial work.

Separate staging concern: Julia study_common.jl uses source-derived historical auxiliary directory; Landlock will safely reject until a reviewed path-only copy overlay redirects it. Replay assessment does not clear output gates.
rows.measurement_alternative: Conditional per-kernel replay; if symbol/managed flag restoration fails use separately reviewed application replay with full host controller and exact checks, not a fixed stage sequence.
rows.memory_tier_review: Device arrays plus small managed control pages; integer-kernel roofline applicability must be explicit.

rows.scope: Static kernel-state/live-host-progress criterion only; no unconditional execution or measured bottleneck claim.
rows.reason: Native OpenMP worker allocates its own cudaMalloc buffer for a disjoint host segment, performs ordered copy/launch/copy/free; Julia worker owns its own CuArray and synchronizes before copying/freeing. No running kernel consumes another CPU worker response or shares its writable buffer.
qualifications: Restore in-place device data before extra passes; retain allocation lifetime until each worker completes all intercepted/replayed operations.
Native may use legacy default stream whereas Julia workers have task stream semantics; per-kernel profiling/serialization does not preserve host-thread concurrency or launch contention.
Original full262144element outputs over both repetitions and all1/2/4/8/16/32worker factors remain mandatory. One first kernel per geometry does not measure all worker copies.
Application replay may have nondeterministic thread/kernel order; do not assume replay matching across host workers without auditing actual stream/context and invocation matching.
rows.measurement_alternative: Conditional per-kernel component counters; timeline instrumentation or explicitly supported range/concurrency profiling for the whole host concurrency question.
rows.memory_tier_review: Device allocation arithmetic plus transfer/allocation costs outside sampled kernel; avoid whole ROI bottleneck inference.

rows.scope: Static kernel-state/live-host-progress criterion only; no unconditional execution or measured bottleneck claim.
rows.reason: Managed A/B are CPU-initialized before the launch loop and inspected after kernel completion, never modified by a live host responder. The kernel updates B+=A, so managed B must be restored before each additional pass.
qualifications: Static state/progress safety does NOT preserve managed page residency. CPU writes every page before timed trials; prefetch changes device placement before each source iteration. Profiler memory backup/restore and cache flushing can change this physical state.

Current first invocation per name/geometry selects warmup kernels, not a timed CPU-reset/prepared state. Prefetch/no-prefetch modes share name/geometry: the selector does not distinguish them. Native warmup launches add with no prefetch; Julia launches add then optionally prefetches afterward.

Do not use this raw sample to claim prefetch benefit, migration cost or whole timed ROI compute/memory bound. Device DRAM bytes omit host-link transfer/page-fault work; cache-control all is not a residency-reset protocol.
Original seven-update full-array result check and no automatic CuArray adaptor prefetch policy remain mandatory.
rows.measurement_alternative: Per-kernel replay only as explicitly labeled instrumented sample. For actual policy comparison use a reviewed timed-state selector plus application/single-pass strategy and validated host→device residency/fault/link instrumentation; retain original full workload, no silent prefetch/no-prefetch rewrite.
rows.memory_tier_review: Unified managed memory: device DRAM versus host-resident/migrating pages must be measured, not inferred from pointer type.

findings.text: for(int trial=1;trial<=5;trial++){for(auto&c:cs)init(c);CK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());std::vector<double>times;for(auto&c:cs){auto start=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();for(int r=0;r<7;r++){if(c.mode){cudaMemLocation loc;loc.type=cudaMemLocationTypeDevice;loc.id=0;CK(cudaMemPrefetchAsync(c.a,c.n*4,loc,0));CK(cudaMemPrefetchAsync(c.b,c.n*4,loc,0));}add<<<(c.n+255)/256,256>>>(c.n,c.a,c.b);CK(cudaGetLastError());CK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());}times.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()-start).count()/7);}auto out=prefix;bool ok=true;double time=0;for(auto t:times)time+=t;for(auto&c:cs){for(int i=0;i<c.n;i++){float a=c.n==4099?1.f:float(i%17-8)/16.f;float b=c.n==4099?2.f:float((i*5)%23-11)/32.f;ok&=c.a[i]==a&&c.b[i]==b+7*a;out.push_back(c.a[i]);}for(int i=0;i<c.n;i++)out.push_back(c.b[i]);}all&=ok;std::string path=std::string(getenv("STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR")?getenv("STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR"):".")+"/output_trial"+std::to_string(trial)+".bin";FILE*f=fopen(path.c_str(),"wb");if(!f)return 4;fwrite(out.data(),4,out.size(),f);fclose(f);printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"component_seconds\":[%.12g,%.12g,%.12g,%.12g],\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":4210712,\"max_abs_error\":%d,\"max_rel_error\":%d,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":7,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"float32\",\"count\":%zu,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,time,times[0],times[1],times[2],times[3],ok?"true":"false",ok?0:1,ok?0:1,path.c_str(),out.size());}for(auto&c:cs){CK(cudaFree(c.a));CK(cudaFree(c.b));}puts(all?"PASS":"FAIL");return all?0:1;}
